summary: refactor(settings): remove unused getStoredAccountData from cache
description:
## Because

- `getStoredAccountData` in `packages/fxa-settings/src/lib/cache.ts` has no callers in the repo.
- The type safety gap in its TODO comment is already covered. `isValidUid` in the same file gates the account cache accessors.

## This pull request

- Removes the `getStoredAccountData` function and its TODO comment from `cache.ts`.

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-8454
